text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Goooood morning, Trainer! Call me<n>the dancing
queen, because I've<n>finally broken through the
limits of<n>conventional dancing!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Beneath the starlit skies, I came up<n>with the Pearl
Tango, a whole new<n>style of body language!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Burning the midnight oil allowed me to<n>produce a
fantastic result that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It appears that Seeking the Pearl<n>didn't get a very
good night's rest<n>since she spent the night dancing
away.
